India participates in UNGA sideline meetings on global issues

India engaged in multiple meetings on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly (UNGA) in New York. One meeting focused on UN reforms, climate change, and counter-terrorism, involving India and CARICOM (Caribbean Community). Another meeting saw India, France, and the UAE review the West Asia situation. These discussions occurred during the UNGA session.
